captions.detailed: This 3D model is an open-style knitting stitch marker designed as a flat, spiral-like ring with a tapered opening slot. It consists of a circular main loop with a flat profile and a smooth, continuous outer edge that extends into a pointed, rounded hook shape on one side, creating a narrow entry gap. The entire part is thin and uniform in thickness, allowing it to easily slip onto a knitting needle and stay in place.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric open-style knitting stitch marker in OpenSCAD. The design should allow users to adjust the needle_size (diameter in mm), ring width, thickness, clearance, and slot_width, featuring a tapered hook extension created with a hull operation to guide the yarn/needle smoothly into the loop.
captions.factory: The script uses a 2D layout extruded with linear_extrude to the specified 'thickness'. The 2D profile is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The positive volume is a union() of a main circle (sized by needle_size, width, and clearance) and a hull() of two translated circles of different radii representing the tapered hook. The negative volume subtracted consists of a scaled circle for the inner needle hole and a translated square to create the entry slot.
